name: using-tui-designer
description: Use when building or reviewing interactive terminal applications, especially capability detection, rendering, input/focus, terminal restoration, accessibility, and cross-environment behavior.

findings.excerpt: | **Rust (ratatui/crossterm)** | `cargo install`, prebuilt static binary (musl), Homebrew, cargo-binstall, distro pkg | Static-link (musl) so it runs on minimal
| **Go (Bubble Tea)** | single static binary, Homebrew, `go install`, GoReleaser | Easiest story — one static binary per OS/arch; still test on Windows Terminal
| **JS (Ink)** | `npm i -g`, `npx`, pkg/bun single-file | Node cold-start + `node_modules` weight; `npx` re-download latency; ensure `isTTY` checks work under t
- **Blocking call inside the input/render loop.** `requests.get(...)` / `cmd.Output()` / a synchronous DB query right where you handle keys. The whole UI freeze
